name: Hoshi Ori Yume Mirai - Rikka to Anata no 1-Shuunen Kinen, Icha Love Birthday
original_name: 星織ユメミライ 律佳とあなたの1周年記念、いちゃらぶバースデー
source:
A short fandisc made to mark Narusawa Rikka's birthday.
The special project "Narusawa Rikka's Great Birthday Festival" by the live radio program "Wish on a Star".

[Translated from the [url=http://toneworks.product.co.jp/hoshiori/rkbd.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
为纪念鸣泽立花生日而制作的短同人光盘。
广播节目“向星星许愿”的特别企划“鸣泽六花的生日祭”。
